scope: Cargo crates and three levels appended to the existing campaign.
creation: RecipeImporter.ImportInto + LevelDocument.Save in Unity; the runtime JSON was not hand-authored.

authoringUi.input: UI Toolkit NavigationSubmit/PointerDown/PointerUp and native value change callbacks; UGUI raycast-verified PointerClick on Save Reference.

recoveries.issue: PlayMode loaded three catalog entries after the initial asset edit was rolled back during authoring tests/Undo.
recoveries.resolution: Cleared Undo for this catalog edit only, saved via ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo, force-imported, verified disk and domain reload, reran both suites.

recoveries.issue: Domain reload left an orphaned test job in an idle temporary test scene.
recoveries.resolution: Confirmed not playing/compiling/running tests; cleared orphan, restored Bootstrap, temporarily disabled domain reload for the rerun; restored original editor options afterwards.

recoveries.issue: Initial narrow-corridor spawn facing caused the third-person camera to move inside the robot.
recoveries.resolution: Adjusted L04 facing to W and L05/L06 to N; replayed and rebound all three proofs, inspected the openings, reran the L03-L06 animation/navigation test.

limits: No new standalone Windows build in this iteration.
Camera inspection covers the new openings and top-down layout, not all possible orbit angles.
